parsed.explanation: No visitor-facing criminalisation of gender expression, no documented border screening, facility ban, police targeting or trans-specific violence appears — but the record is thin on visitor experience, so structural signals govern. Weighting negatives: an in-force state architecture of erasure (2020 decree barring marker correction), documented official demonisation (PM statements, smear campaigns, child-protection scapegoating) which licenses social hostility, and no documented protection actually operating for trans visitors. Positives: same-sex conduct legal since 1961, registered partnerships, large public Prides, functioning courts issuing landmark pro-LGBTI rulings, EU oversight, and a post-2026 election political shift — climate signals rather than traveller protections. Resident-facing LGR absence and adoption/marriage rules carry little weight. Worst documented feature is state hostility plus paper protections, not tier-1 exclusion or organised targeting; consequences if outed look like discrimination and confrontation, not imprisonment. Sits just above mid-elevated.
